title: Wee Willie Winkie 🌙 | Tiny Tune Town Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs
intro: Shh, it's bedtime! Big brother Kofi plays Wee Willie Winkie in his nightgown with a little lantern. He and Nomi tiptoe through the house at eight o'clock to see who is asleep: Mango the cat in the basket, Nana in her armchair, and Nomi in her cosy bed. Then Mum and Dad tuck Kofi in. A gentle bedtime lullaby of the classic nursery rhyme for toddlers and preschoolers.
actions: Count to eight o'clock on the clock
Close your eyes and snuggle up in bed
credit: Traditional public-domain nursery rhyme (William Miller, 1841; printed in The Real Mother Goose, 1916). New verses and music by Tiny Tune Town.
